countermodel_registry.name: semantic_field_omitted
countermodel_registry.witness: Different semantics share canonical bytes.

countermodel_registry.name: nonsemantic_field_included
countermodel_registry.witness: Equivalent semantics receive different canonical bytes.

countermodel_registry.name: naked_digest_cross_domain
countermodel_registry.witness: A value address is consumed as an occurrence or judgment address.

countermodel_registry.name: unsupported_terms_collapsed
countermodel_registry.witness: Unsupported terms collapse to one false/none address.

countermodel_registry.name: fuel_dependent_address
countermodel_registry.witness: The same term receives different semantic identity under different sufficient resources.

countermodel_registry.name: same_digest_different_bytes
countermodel_registry.witness: A store reuses a digest without comparing canonical bytes.

countermodel_registry.name: dangling_child_address
countermodel_registry.witness: A graph root resolves while a referenced child is unavailable.

countermodel_registry.name: naive_recursive_self_hash
countermodel_registry.witness: A cyclic graph attempts direct recursive content hashing.

countermodel_registry.name: vacuous_goal
countermodel_registry.witness: Claim=True or an empty mandatory-goal set produces false closure.

countermodel_registry.name: irrelevant_goal_split
countermodel_registry.witness: A hard parent goal is replaced by easy unrelated children.

countermodel_registry.name: stale_green_reused
countermodel_registry.witness: A changed dependency leaves an old GREEN judgment active.

countermodel_registry.name: await_hides_stuck
countermodel_registry.witness: An unresolvable goal is labeled Await without a causal wake.

countermodel_registry.name: reepoch_churn
countermodel_registry.witness: Real but irrelevant epoch deltas carry a mandatory goal forever.

countermodel_registry.name: revision_mislabeled_growth
countermodel_registry.witness: Breaking old semantics is presented as conservative theory growth.

countermodel_registry.name: circular_support
countermodel_registry.witness: Two closed judgments support each other without an external root.

countermodel_registry.name: archive_corruption_silent
countermodel_registry.witness: Malformed or missing evidence is skipped and closure remains active.

countermodel_registry.name: common_fixture_root
countermodel_registry.witness: Multiple engines share one incomplete fixture generator and are miscounted as independent.

countermodel_registry.name: key_distinct_control_same
countermodel_registry.witness: Distinct public keys share one custodian/control domain.

countermodel_registry.name: two_of_three_conflicting_qc

countermodel_registry.name: signer_lock_lost
countermodel_registry.witness: A signer crashes, forgets its vote lock, and signs a conflict.

countermodel_registry.name: authority_config_overlap
countermodel_registry.witness: Old and new signer configurations finalize conflicting successors.

countermodel_registry.name: cross_slot_double_spend
countermodel_registry.witness: Two unique slots each validate against the same stale balance and violate the global invariant.

countermodel_registry.name: incomplete_footprint
countermodel_registry.witness: Disjoint writes share an undeclared invariant domain.

countermodel_registry.name: old_key_long_range_forgery
countermodel_registry.witness: Later compromise of retired keys forges an unanchored past certificate.

countermodel_registry.name: mobile_adversary_accumulation

countermodel_registry.name: content_q_as_occurrence_q

countermodel_registry.name: effect_applied_history_missing
